name: Inbound Lead Response SLA Owner Evidence Checklist
buyer_pain_language: chatbot or call answering before CRM cleanup
safe_answer: Use the AICS inbound lead response SLA owner-evidence checklist when a buyer needs to prove source, queue, response owner, handoff stop-rule and claim boundaries before buying an AI SDR, chatbot, CRM workflow, call answering service or agency follow-up system.
claim_boundaries: No recovered revenue, ROI, conversion lift or lead-volume claim
No legal, privacy, security, medical or compliance advice
